decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 10 Conway Road.

Condition : 7 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used. In particular, the side extension that has already been built shall be altered by removing the part of the extension that extends in front of the original front building line of the house. This alteration should take place before 1st May 2006 unless the Local Planning Authority agrees otherwise in writing.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, single storey rear extension, rear dormer window and extension to shed
